cues.zh: 这门课的目的是为你们的技术未来做好准备。

cues.en: There really is, in this course, no technical content. Although I'm gonna talk about digital filters and all kinds of things, there are things you presumably know. I am concerned about style.

cues.zh: 从我在战争期间待在 Los Alamos 起，我就一直在研究伟大的科学家。那些做出重要成就的人，和没能做出重要成就的人，有什么不同？

cues.en: Mainly, it's a matter of style.
cues.zh: 主要区别在于做事风格。

cues.en: Many a person I've known worked just as hard as others, but didn't have much to show for it.
cues.zh: 我认识很多人，他们和其他人一样努力，却没做出什么成果。

cues.en: So my problem is to instill in you something called style so you'll amount to something. After all, the navy is paying a large sum of money to have you here,
cues.zh: 所以，我要做的是让你们养成一种叫作风格的东西，这样你们才能有所成就。毕竟，海军花了一大笔钱让你们来这里，

cues.zh: 把这笔钱挣回来。

cues.en: Now I will examine, criticize, and talk about various people's style, mainly my own,
cues.zh: 现在我要审视、批评并谈论各种人的风格，主要是我自己的，

cues.en: but other people's where I can use it.
cues.zh: 但别人的，是我能用得上的地方。

cues.en: Now, there are many of things I'm gonna tell you I wish somebody had told me.
cues.zh: 接下来我要告诉你们很多事，我希望当年有人能告诉我。

cues.en: I had to find out for myself.
cues.zh: 我得自己去弄清楚。

cues.en: This course is not a normal technical course. It's all about the topics they never told you in class that they should have. Because
cues.zh: 这门课不是普通的技术课。它讲的全是课堂上没人告诉你、但其实早该讲的那些话题。因为

cues.en: each course is taught this way and a large amount falls in between.
cues.zh: 每门课都是这样教的，而大量内容介于两者之间。

cues.en: That's what I'm trying to pick up.
cues.zh: 这正是我想要掌握的。

cues.en: Now style cannot be put into words.
cues.zh: 风格无法用言语表达。

cues.en: I can only approach it by particular examples and let you infer what it is.
cues.zh: 我只能通过具体例子来接近它，让你自己推断它是什么。

cues.en: Now there is a belief that you probably have that anything can be talked about.
cues.zh: 现在你可能有一种信念，认为任何事都可以谈论。

cues.en: This goes back to Socrates,
cues.zh: 这可以追溯到苏格拉底，

cues.en: Plato,
cues.zh: Plato，

cues.en: Aristotle, and the early Greek times.
cues.zh: 亚里士多德，以及古希腊时期。

cues.en: They thought they could talk about the gods, truth, beauty, justice,
cues.zh: 他们以为可以谈论神、真理、美、正义，

cues.en: love, all those things.
cues.zh: 热爱，所有这些事情。

cues.en: At the time they were saying these things, there were the mystery cults
cues.zh: 当时，他们所说的这些事情与神秘宗教有关

cues.en: in Greece
cues.zh: 在希腊

cues.en: who said,
cues.zh: 谁说，

cues.en: you must experience,
cues.zh: 你必须经历，

cues.en: you cannot talk.
cues.zh: 你没法说话。

cues.en: And if you remember the middle ages, various saints said,
cues.zh: 如果你还记得中世纪，各种圣人都说过，

cues.en: you can't talk about God,
cues.zh: 你不能谈论上帝，

cues.en: you've got to experience him.
cues.zh: 你必须亲自体验一下他。

cues.en: In the same way the Mohammedans,
cues.zh: 同样地，伊斯兰教徒们，

cues.en: about Allah,
cues.zh: 关于安拉，

cues.en: you can't portray him, you can't put pictures,
cues.zh: 你没法描绘他，没法放图片，

cues.en: you must sense.
cues.zh: 你必须感知。

cues.zh: 一直以来都有一种观点认为，你无法把所有事物都用语言表达出来，

cues.en: and one of them is style.
cues.zh: 其中之一就是风格。

cues.en: Struggle hoping that you will get the idea.
cues.zh: 努力去理解，希望你能领会。

cues.zh: 我发现，要想让这样的课程真正有效，我得谈谈自己。

cues.en: If I make abstract remarks, it just sounds like so many pious words. If I talk about me and what I've done,

cues.zh: 也许就能真正打动你。

cues.en: Now it gives the course an attitude of bragging.
cues.zh: 可这样一来，课程就带上了自吹自擂的味道。

cues.zh: 我总是谈论自己。

cues.en: so you won't do the same sort of a thing.
cues.zh: 这样你就不会重蹈覆辙。

cues.en: Similarly, I have to get you to quit your modesty.
cues.zh: 同样，我得让你放下你的谦逊。

cues.en: I have to get you individually
cues.zh: 我得让你们每个人

cues.en: to respond to my challenge that you're gonna be great.
cues.zh: 去回应我的挑战——你会成为了不起的人。

cues.en: And you have to say to yourself, yes. If that guy, Hamming, did go out and become a great scientist,
cues.zh: 你要对自己说，是的。如果那个叫Hamming的人都能走出去成为伟大的科学家，

cues.en: I can.
cues.zh: 我也能。

cues.en: Or I can become a great person.
cues.zh: 或者我能成为一个了不起的人。

cues.en: I have to get you to say to yourself that you want to,
cues.zh: 我得让你对自己说，你想做到，

cues.en: that it's worth the effort, and you're going to try to be something more than just the average person.
cues.zh: 这值得付出努力，你要努力成为超越平庸的人。

cues.en: Now,
cues.zh: 现在，

cues.en: while we speak of teachers,
cues.zh: 说到老师，

cues.en: we are really coaches.
cues.zh: 我们其实是教练。

cues.en: I cannot run a mile, the four minute mile for you.
cues.zh: 我没法替你跑完一英里，跑出四分钟一英里的成绩。

cues.en: I can comment upon your style,
cues.zh: 我可以点评你的风格，

cues.en: but you know
cues.zh: 但你知道

cues.en: you must do the work.
cues.zh: 功课必须你自己做。

cues.en: The same way I cannot make you a great scientist.
cues.zh: 同样，我也没法把你变成伟大的科学家。

cues.en: I can criticize style and other things,
cues.zh: 我可以批评你的风格以及其他方面，

cues.en: but I cannot,
cues.zh: 但我没法，

cues.en: by mere words, make you a great scientist.
cues.zh: 仅凭言语，就把你变成伟大的科学家。

cues.en: You, just as in running four minute mile, must do the work,
cues.zh: 你，就像跑四分钟一英里一样，必须自己下功夫，

cues.en: which means you have to take what you hear and read,
cues.zh: 这意味着你得把听到的、读到的内容，

cues.en: think it over carefully, discuss with your friends, and see what you can adapt to yourself.
cues.zh: 仔细思考，和朋友讨论，看看哪些能为你所用。

cues.en: There is no one style which is successful.
cues.zh: 没有哪一种风格是成功的。

cues.en: Painters paint many different styles.
cues.zh: 画家会画很多不同的风格。

cues.en: You have to find a style if it's you, which means you have to take what fragments you can from other people,
cues.zh: 你必须找到适合你的风格，这意味着你得从别人那里汲取你能拿来的片段，

cues.en: use them,
cues.zh: 用起来，

cues.en: and adapt them and become yours.
cues.zh: 加以调整，变成你自己的。

cues.en: You can't copy me directly. You won't get away with it.
cues.zh: 你不能直接照搬我。那样行不通。

cues.en: And I will use the analogy of painting as an example.
cues.zh: 我拿绘画来打个比方。

cues.en: In painting, once you've learned
cues.zh: 在绘画里，一旦你学会了

cues.en: color mixing and form and sketching and so on, you study under a master who you temporarily accept as knowing what he's talking about.
cues.zh: 调色、造型、素描等等，你就跟着一位大师学，暂时认定他懂自己在讲什么。

cues.en: Well,
cues.zh: 嗯，

cues.en: there are limits what can be done.
cues.zh: 能做的总是有限的。

cues.en: You
cues.zh: 你

cues.en: know that if you copy the master style exactly,
cues.zh: 知道，如果完全照搬大师的风格，

cues.en: you will not be a great painter.
cues.zh: 你成不了伟大的画家。

cues.en: You know also that if you paint in the style he did or she did,
cues.zh: 你也知道，如果你按他或她的风格来画，

cues.en: it's too late. The future wants a different style.
cues.zh: 那就太晚了。未来要的是不同的风格。

cues.en: Thus, I can tell you about the style I used in the past,
cues.zh: 所以，我可以告诉你我过去用的风格，

cues.en: but that won't be the style you'll have to have to cope with the future.
cues.zh: 但那不会是你应对未来必须拥有的风格。

cues.en: You must manufacture
cues.zh: 你必须打造出

cues.en: the style which will make you a significant person in the future.
cues.zh: 能让你在未来成为重要人物的那种风格。

cues.en: So it's not easy. Well, I can only talk about past ones and make references to possible future ones.
cues.zh: 所以这并不容易。我只能谈谈过去的，再提一提未来可能的。

cues.en: It's a problem you face.
cues.zh: 这是你要面对的问题。

cues.en: What I did would not make me successful if I were starting now.
cues.zh: 如果我今天从头开始，我当年做的那些并不会让我成功。

cues.en: Just as my predecessor got successful on other things that I couldn't do and get successful on.
cues.zh: 就像我的前辈靠别的事情成功，而那些事我做不来、也做不成功。

cues.en: Now, it's another part that's very difficult for you.
cues.zh: 现在，还有另一部分对你们来说非常难。

cues.en: When I went to Bell Talbot Laboratories in 1946,
cues.zh: 1946年我去贝尔实验室时，

cues.en: I looked around since I was already interested in what made great scientists,
cues.zh: 我四处观察，因为我那时已经对是什么造就了伟大科学家很感兴趣，

cues.en: and I looked at what they did.
cues.zh: 我观察他们做了什么。

cues.en: And when I looked at what they did to become famous,
cues.zh: 而当我看看他们靠什么成名时，

cues.en: it didn't look that difficult.
cues.zh: 看起来并没那么难。

cues.en: They tend to do the easy problems. Now I found in the course of my time there, a couple of holes they left. But fundamentally,
cues.zh: 他们倾向于做容易的问题。我在那儿工作期间，发现了几处他们留下的空白。但从根本上说，

cues.en: they did the easy problems.
cues.zh: 他们做的是容易的问题。

cues.en: My generation did the somewhat harder ones.
cues.zh: 我们这一代做的是稍难一些的问题。

cues.en: And we left to the others
cues.zh: 而我们把留给别人的

cues.en: the harder still.
cues.zh: 是更难的。

cues.en: Every generation has more difficulty.
cues.zh: 每一代都更难。

cues.en: But you stand on our shoulders to some extent, yet the task is harder.
cues.zh: 但你们在某种程度上站在我们肩上，任务却更难。

cues.en: Having got man to the moon,
cues.zh: 人类已经登上了月球，

cues.en: the next real good feat in space is gonna be a lot harder.
cues.zh: 太空中的下一个真正壮举会难得多。

cues.en: Therefore, have difficulty that's very definite.
cues.zh: 所以，难度是非常明确的。

cues.en: Now when I came to Bell Labs, there were four of us at the same time about.
cues.zh: 我来到 Bell Labs 时，我们大约四个人是同时来的。

cues.en: We came in about the same time, and we were about the same age within a year.
cues.zh: 我们差不多同时进来，年龄也相差不到一岁。

cues.en: We privately called ourselves the four young Turks.
cues.zh: 私下里我们自称“四个少壮派”。

cues.en: And many, years later, I discovered top management called us the same.
cues.zh: 很多年后我发现，高层管理也这么叫我们。

cues.en: We were troublemakers.
cues.zh: 我们是麻烦制造者。

cues.en: We didn't do things the way the previous generation did. We did new things.
cues.zh: 我们不像上一代那样做事。我们做新东西。

cues.en: The previous generation didn't like it.
cues.zh: 上一代不喜欢这样。

cues.en: We didn't do things right.
cues.zh: 我们做事不按老规矩。

cues.en: For example, my boss, Henrik Bode, in network theory had made a reputation doing network theory with complex variable and knew that's how you do things. After all, that is what made him famous.
cues.zh: 比如，我的老板 Henrik Bode 在网络理论领域靠用复变量做网络理论出了名，他知道事情就该那么做。毕竟，那正是让他成名的方式。

cues.en: This guy, Hammond, comes along and keeps using computing machines, which is not the way to do it in his eyes.
cues.zh: 这个叫 Hammond 的家伙来了，老是用计算机器，而在他眼里这不是做事的方法。

cues.en: But it was the thing that needed to be done.
cues.zh: 但这正是当时需要做的事。

cues.en: This is a lesson which I wanna get across to you regularly.
cues.zh: 我想把这个道理经常讲给你们听。

cues.en: Supposing I am successful and you do rise to the top,
cues.zh: 假设我成功了，而你们确实登上了顶峰，

cues.en: will you please remember
cues.zh: 请你们记住

cues.en: that what made you great
cues.zh: 让你们变得卓越的东西

cues.en: is not appropriate for the next generation?
cues.zh: 对下一代并不适用。

cues.en: You know how to get great because after all you were great,
cues.zh: 你们知道如何变得卓越，毕竟你们曾经卓越，

cues.en: but the things that you did may not be appropriate for the next generation.
cues.zh: 但你们做过的那些事，可能并不适合下一代。

cues.en: All too often, we have a troubled bosses. They know by God, this is the way I did it and I got the top, it must be right.
cues.zh: 太多时候，我们会遇到一些爱找麻烦的老板。他们觉得，老天作证，我就是这么干的，我登上了顶峰，这肯定是对的。

cues.en: They're very often wrong. And I want you to think seriously when you rise to the top that your method of success is not appropriate
cues.zh: 他们往往错了。我希望你们认真思考：当你们登上顶峰时，你们的成功方法并不适用

cues.en: now that the world has changed.
cues.zh: 因为世界已经变了。

cues.en: I wanna talk to education.
cues.zh: 我想谈谈教育。

cues.en: Education is
cues.zh: 教育是

cues.en: what, when, and why to do things.
cues.zh: 做什么、何时做、为什么做。

cues.en: Training is how to do it.
cues.zh: 训练是如何去做。

cues.en: Most of your courses have been training.
cues.zh: 你们的大多数课程都是训练。

cues.en: I'm trying to talk about the education part.
cues.zh: 我想谈的是教育的那部分。

cues.en: It's not easy.
cues.zh: 这并不容易。

cues.en: But the school has allowed me a great deal of latitude in putting this course together, which is concentrating on education.
cues.zh: 但学校给了我很大的自由度来组织这门课，重点就在教育上。

cues.en: Now if you have one without the other, it's not much good.
cues.zh: 如果你只有其中一个而没有另一个，那就没多大用处。

cues.en: I've had very able technical people reporting to me who applied their technology and the methods to the wrong problem, and it had to be undone.
cues.zh: 我曾有非常能干的技术人员向我汇报，他们把技术和方​​法用在了错误的问题上，结果不得不推倒重来。

cues.en: And I have other people who had all kinds of theory but couldn't do anything.
cues.zh: 我也有另一些人，理论一大套，却什么也做不了。

cues.en: They're not much use either.
cues.zh: 他们也派不上什么用场。

cues.en: You need both theory to guide you and skill and technique to do.
cues.zh: 你需要理论来指引你，也需要技能和技巧来做事。

cues.en: One without the other
cues.zh: 没有其中一个，另一个也不太好。

cues.en: isn't too good.
cues.zh: 也不太好。

cues.en: Now in a certain sense, I'm engaged in medis education.
cues.zh: 从某种意义上说，我正在从事医学教育。

cues.en: I'm talking about education constantly because that's what you're going to have to do. You're gonna have to educate yourself constantly.
cues.zh: 我一直在谈教育，因为你们今后必须这么做。你们必须不断自我教育。

cues.en: That's what the future says.
cues.zh: 未来就是这么告诉我们的。

cues.en: Now I'm gonna constantly try and project forward what the world's gonna be like.
cues.zh: 现在，我会不断尝试向前推演这个世界将会是什么样子。

cues.en: Let's look back first to history.
cues.zh: 我们先回顾一下历史。

cues.en: The modern era in science and engineering began with Sir Isaac Newton roughly.
cues.zh: 现代科学和工程时代大致始于艾萨克·牛顿爵士。

cues.en: he was born Christmas
cues.zh: 他出生在圣诞节，

cues.en: day, the same year that Galileo died and he lived to be about 85.
cues.zh: 那一年伽利略去世，而他活到了大约85岁。

cues.en: So we can say it's around 1700.
cues.zh: 所以我们可以说，大约是在1700年。

cues.en: From from Newton's time to ours,
cues.zh: 从牛顿时代到现在，

cues.en: we have about doubled the knowledge every seventeen years.
cues.zh: 我们的知识量大约每17年翻一番。

cues.en: The doubling period of science from then to now
cues.zh: 从那时到现在，科学知识的翻倍周期

cues.zh: 你就会像个醉汉一样乱走

cues.zh: 那才是我真正追求的关键部分。某种意义上，这也正是这门课的目的，

cues.en: It's not a fact. It's an opinion that most people believe that the struggle to do... Achieve excellence is worth the struggle.
cues.zh: 不是事实。这是一种观点——大多数人相信，为追求卓越而奋斗是值得的。

cues.en: Also, you look at people's lives,
cues.zh: 另外，你看看人们的生活，

cues.en: I can tell you a story which I may repeat a couple of times.
cues.zh: 我可以讲个故事，也许后面还会重复几次。

cues.en: As a child, I went to a movie.
cues.zh: 小时候，我去看过一场电影。

cues.en: They were called Nickelodeons of my day, we actually spent a dime to go to the movie. One Saturday, went with a friend of mine and it was one of these...
cues.zh: 我那个年代叫五分钱影院，我们真的花一角钱去看电影。有个周六，我和一个朋友去了，是那种……

cues.en: You laughed and laughed and laughed, all ridiculous
cues.zh: 你笑啊笑啊笑个不停，全是荒诞的

cues.en: situations.
cues.zh: 情节。

cues.en: We walked out and he said to me,
cues.zh: 我们走出来，他对我说，

cues.en: you know, that wasn't a very funny movie.
cues.zh: 你知道吗，那电影其实没那么好笑。

cues.en: I thought for a while and said, you're right. All the laughter did not make the movie funny at all.
cues.zh: 我想了一会儿说，你说得对。那些笑声根本没让电影变得好笑。

cues.en: And the same way with life.
cues.zh: 生活也是如此。

cues.en: The pleasant life is not the ones...
cues.zh: 愉快的人生并不是那些……

cues.en: The sum total of the pleasant moments.
cues.zh: 愉快时刻的总和。

cues.en: Somehow or others added up very, very differently.
cues.zh: 不知怎的，加总起来结果截然不同。

cues.en: The good life is not the life of pleasure from moment to moment and you know it. In fact, you are well aware that you cannot get up in the morning and say, I shall be happy today
cues.zh: 美好的人生不是每时每刻都充满享乐的人生，这你心里清楚。事实上，你很清楚，你不能早上起来就说，我今天要快乐

cues.en: and make it work.
cues.zh: 然后就能做到。

cues.en: The good life has to be snuck up upon.
cues.zh: 好生活得悄悄去靠近。

cues.en: And I'm saying the...
cues.zh: 而我是说……

cues.en: An opinion of myself and many other books, the way to do that is to
cues.zh: 我自己的看法，以及许多其他书里的看法是，做到这一点的方法就是

cues.en: take yourself in hand and manage yourself to be the person you wish to be to achieve the goals you wish and be more articulate than just idle drifting like a drunken sailor.
cues.zh: 掌控自己、管好自己，成为你想成为的人，实现你想要的目标，活得更清楚明白，而不是像喝醉的水手那样闲散漂泊。

cues.en: Now in ancient Greece,
cues.zh: 话说在古希腊，

cues.en: our boy Socrates
cues.zh: 咱们这位 Socrates

cues.en: said,
cues.zh: 说过，

cues.en: the unexamined life is not worth living.
cues.zh: 未经省察的人生不值得过。

cues.en: So what I'm saying goes back that far.
cues.zh: 所以我说的话可以追溯到那么早。

cues.en: I was crossing Yale campus one time as
cues.zh: 有一次我穿过 Yale 校园，当时我是

cues.en: a consultant for the present on a job, a whole committee put together, I walked across. I heard a professor walking across the campus right ahead of me saying to a student,
cues.zh: 某个项目的顾问——整个委员会一起做的项目——我走过校园时，听到正前方一位教授边走边对学生说，

cues.en: the unexamined life is not worth living.
cues.zh: 未经省察的人生不值得过。

cues.en: And in the course of cross crossing one quadrangle,
cues.zh: 而在穿过一个四方院的过程中，

cues.en: he managed to say it three times.
cues.zh: 他居然说了三遍。

cues.en: So I'll repeat it the third time.
cues.zh: 那我再说第三遍。

cues.en: The unexamined life is not worth living.
cues.zh: 未经省察的人生不值得过。

cues.en: See you
cues.zh: 回头见

cues.en: Thursday. Right? And there are notes here on the course. And if there aren't enough, I'll bring some more tomorrow. Out to Thursday.
cues.zh: 周四。对吧？这里还有课程讲义。如果不够，我明天再带一些来。那就周四见。
